release_notes:
What's New in v1.1.6

- Instant Community Members Loading: Fixed contact loading when scheduling a video call with instant offline caching and retry support.
- Selective Video Call Scheduling: Choose specific members by registration name to receive call rings, or choose 'Select All' to invite everyone.
- Selective Ringing: Call ring notifications are sent only to the invited members instead of ringing all phones.
- Real-time Member Search: Search members instantly by name or phone in the call scheduler.
- General stability, audio clarity, and performance improvements across live prayer meetings.
